answer: Make each new agent pass a paid probe: a verifier sends it a small job, like grading ten timber-yard invoices, and checks the answers against known results. Fake accounts cost real compute per probe, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand times more. Passing agents get a low work quota that grows with history, the way a ferry slot at a jetty is booked in advance, and one account watching from a knoll cannot claim many.
